name: Altstadt Genusshotel Auracher Löchl
beschreibung: The Altstadt Genusshotel Auracher Löchl is housed in a historic building within the charming Kufstein Old Town. The hotel’s location in the pedestrian zone offers quick access to the fortress and the Inn River. Guests enjoy individually styled rooms with modern comforts. The restaurant specializes in Tyrolean cuisine made with local ingredients. A wellness area featuring a sauna and steam bath is available for relaxation. As a Genusshotel (pleasure hotel), the property blends central convenience with exceptional gastronomy.
